# Sans Mercantile

> Sans Mercantile is a South African-registered, AI-driven global trade and fintech company operating a constellation of 21 specialised, autonomous AI systems for global commerce, governance and innovation. CIPC Registration No: K2025537335. Founded by Mezzoforte Privilège. Headquarters: Cape Town, South Africa.

Key products:

- [Priv Core](https://priv.sansmercantile.com/): Autonomous trading desk and AI trading terminal — strategy backtesting, 24/7 market watch, full user custody. Free tier available.
- [Priv Pay](https://privpay.sansmercantile.com/): B2B payment platform with developer APIs, white-label branding and mobile apps.
- [Priv Philanthropy](https://www.sansmercantile.com/priv/philanthropy/): Structured giving, endowments and community foundation programmes.
